info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts Investments Universe API
Query entitled universe to retrieve investment metadata

params.name: universe
params.description: Filters results to a custom universe defined during implementation for the account.

params.name: source
params.description: Specifies the investment data type to query.

params.name: exchangeCode
params.description: Primary filter for equities. Filters results by exchange code.

params.name: securityType
params.description:
Secondary filter for equities. Accepts:

  *   `ST00000001` - Common Stock
  *   `ST00000002` - Preferred Stock
  *   `ST00000003` - Industry
  *   `ST00000004` - Index
  *   `ST00000005` - ETF
  *   `ST00000006` - Closed-end Fund
  *   `ST00000007` - Investment Trusts
  *   `ST00000008` - Warrant
  *   `ST00000009` - Note
  *   `ST000000A1` - Units
  *   `ST000000B1` - Rights
  *   `ST000000C1` - Unlisted Common
  *   `ST000000C2` - Unlisted Preferred

params.name: countryAvailableForSaleCode
params.description: Primary filter for managed investments. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: domicileCode
params.description: Primary filter for managed investments. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: shareClassInformationInvestmentType
params.description:
Secondary filter for equities.

Accepts:

  *   `EQ` - Equity
  *   `DR` - Depository Receipt
  *   `PE` - Preferred Equity
  *   `UE` - Unlisted Equity

params.name: paginationTokenNext
params.description: Specifies the token to fetch the next page of results.

params.name: paginationTokenPrevious
params.description: Specifies the token to fetch the previous page of results.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Specifies the number of records per page.

items.docs:
**Get Universe Entitlements**

Retrieve the **primary filters** your account is entitled for.

| Scenario| Request Inputs |
|-----------|-------|
| Get equities entitlements.| `GET /investments`|
| Get managed investments entitlements.| `GET /investments?source=managedInvestments` |

**Get Custom Universe**

Retrieve a custom universe in full.
